description: Empty per-installation source catalog. Review each source and its access conditions before adding it.

extension_policy.new_sources: Add only sources selected by this installation's owner, with stable IDs and evidence.
extension_policy.unknown_values: Use null or unknown when information has not been verified.
extension_policy.deduplication: Compare canonical listing URLs and source relationships before counting results.

capability_policy.notes: An entry in the catalog does not imply an implemented adapter or permission to access a source.

iteration_policy.account_source_resolution: Confirm the authentication provider; do not assume that accounts are shared between sources.
iteration_policy.notes: Discovery is informational. Verify current listing terms; this software does not bid, contact sellers, or create source accounts.
